name: relai-panel
description: RelAI panel for Claude Code (early access mods): a card above the prompt with the active plan and stage and the session's hypothetical API cost (the prompt-cache timer is relai-cache-keeper's); /relai-panel opens a pane with forms for the 14 RelAI commands, the project's cheat sheet, the session phrases and the session's measured costs (main loop, subagents, compactions; per agent and model, priced at a dated list). Measurements go to .claude/relai/pomiary/, a file per session. Silent outside RelAI projects.
